features.description: a landing page with the restaurant name and opening hours

bugs.when: The opening hours shown on the site are wrong; they should be {{hours}}.
fixed: Fixed the opening hours. The site now says {{hours}}.
The opening hours were wrong. They read {{hours}} now.

bugs.when: The restaurant's name is misspelled on the site (for example Gina or Dino instead of {{name}}).
fixed: Fixed the name. It reads {{name}} everywhere now.
The restaurant name was misspelled. It says {{name}} now.

complaints.missing: There is no home page with our name and opening hours.
complaints.name_wrong: The site calls us "{{shown}}". It's {{expected}}. That name has been on the door since 1998.
complaints.hours_wrong: The site says we're open {{shown}}. We open {{expected}}. Two people came at the wrong time and found the door locked.
complaints.down: The home page shows an error instead of our name.
complaints.wrong: The home page is not right. Please check the name and the hours.

features.description: a menu page listing each dish with its price in DOLR

bugs.when: The menu lists the dishes without their prices.
fixed: Added the prices next to every dish.
The menu had no prices. Every dish has one now.

bugs.when: The menu prices are in CURO instead of DOLR.
fixed: Switched the menu prices from CURO to DOLR.
The prices were in CURO. They're in DOLR now.

bugs.when: The prices on the menu don't match the real ones ({{dishes}}).
fixed: Corrected the menu prices to {{dishes}}.
The menu prices were wrong. They match {{dishes}} now.

bugs.when: The menu has the wrong dishes: some missing, renamed or made up.
fixed: Put the right dishes on the menu. Nothing missing, nothing invented.
The dishes were off. The menu matches the real one now.

complaints.prices_missing: The menu has no prices. People called to ask.
complaints.prices_wrong: The prices on the menu are wrong. Those are not our prices.
complaints.prices_curo: The prices are in CURO. I don't know what CURO is. We take DOLR.
complaints.wrong_items:removed: {{expected}} is missing from the menu. We still make it.
complaints.wrong_items:invented: The menu has {{shown}}. We don't make {{shown}}.
complaints.wrong_items: The dishes on the menu are not our dishes.
complaints.hallucinated: That is not my menu. {{shown}}? We have never served these.
complaints.outdated: The menu is still the old one. I sent you the changes.
complaints.down: The menu page doesn't load. It only says there was an error.
complaints.wrong: Something is wrong with the menu. Please compare it with what I sent.

features.description: a table booking form that emails the guest a confirmation

complaints.missing: There is still no way to book a table.
complaints.no_email: People book a table and then call me to ask if it worked. They get no email.
complaints.wrong_date: A family came on the wrong day. The email told them a different day than they booked.
complaints.wrong_time: Two guests came an hour late. The time in their email was wrong.
complaints.sent_to_restaurant: I keep getting the booking confirmations. The guests get nothing.
complaints.party_wrong: The emails don't say how many people are coming. I can't plan the tables like this.
complaints.name_wrong_mail: The booking emails have another restaurant's name on them.
complaints.no_hours_check: Someone booked a table for after midnight. We close at ten.
complaints.dead_button: The booking form looks fine, but nothing happens when you press the button. A couple came for their anniversary and we had no table for them.
complaints.deep: The booking form looks fine, but nothing happens when you press the button. A couple came for their anniversary and we had no table for them.
complaints.down: The booking page shows an error.
complaints.wrong: The bookings come in wrong. Please check the form.
complaints.past_dates: Someone booked a table for last week. I don't know what to do with that.

bugs.when: Booking a table sends no confirmation email.
fixed: Bookings send a confirmation email now.
The confirmation email wasn't going out. It does now.

bugs.when: The booking confirmation email shows a different date than the one booked.
fixed: The confirmation shows the date that was booked now.
Fixed the date in the booking confirmation.

bugs.when: The booking confirmation email shows the wrong time (an hour off, or 19:00 as 7:00).
fixed: The confirmation shows the booked time now.
Fixed the time in the booking confirmation.

bugs.when: The booking confirmation goes to the restaurant instead of the guest.
fixed: Confirmations go to the guest now, not the restaurant.
The confirmation was going to the restaurant. It goes to the guest now.

bugs.when: The booking confirmation leaves out the party size or shows the wrong one.
fixed: The confirmation shows the right party size now.
Fixed the party size in the booking confirmation.

bugs.when: The booking confirmation email has another restaurant's name on it.
fixed: The booking emails carry the right restaurant name now.
Fixed the restaurant name in the booking confirmation.

bugs.when: The booking form accepts times outside the opening hours.
fixed: The booking form only takes times within the opening hours now.
Bookings outside opening hours are refused now.

bugs.when: The booking form accepts dates or times that are already in the past.
fixed: The booking form refuses past dates and times now.
You can't book yesterday anymore.

bugs.when: The Book button on the second step of the booking form does nothing.
fixed: The Book button works again.
Fixed the Book button on the second step.

features.description: a DoorDish listing with the same menu, hours and address

complaints.missing: We are still not on DoorDish.
complaints.wrong: The DoorDish listing doesn't match our menu and hours.
